title: SOLENIS - 1.65tb
description:
SOLENIS — full corporate data dump
1.65 TB · 58,249 files · 336,782,341 CRM records · 20.9 billion Foundry rows · captured October 2026
SOLENIS ->

Customer PII — 5,578,872 accounts and 1,144,801 contacts with names, titles, emails and

  direct-dial phone numbers, plus 166,168 internal user records: the full staff directory.
  110,708,024 account-change rows track how every customer record moved over time.

ALL the accounting data — 20.9 billion rows of Palantir Foundry data across 464 datasets:

  invoices, open AR, cleared items, credit memos, disputed and deducted payments, delivery and
  billing line items, material cost periods, pricing conditions. SAP tables sit in the same
  tree (FBL5N, VBRP, VBAP, DB_B_SAPWPR).

Palantir CRM dumped — every one of them exported in full.
Pricing, per customer, per currency — 192,990,865 price-book rows carrying unit prices and

  currency against 663,207 product records, plus 4,728,337 orders and 668,269 opportunities with
  amounts, stages and close dates.

The correspondence — 396,651 emails with full bodies, headers and recipients; 620,027

  attachment records; 216,195 notes; 438,974 case comments; 1,814,759 tasks; 3,178,282 events.
---
Records
336,782,341 — the complete Salesforce CRM: 5,578,872 customer accounts (names, account
numbers, ship-to locations, industry) and 1,144,801 named contacts with titles, emails and
direct-dial phone numbers; 192,990,865 priced price-book rows (unit price, currency, price book)
against 663,207 products; 4,728,337 orders, 668,269 opportunities with amounts and stages,
1,703,037 installed-base assets; 968,023 service cases with 8,932,562 history rows and 438,974
comments; 396,651 emails with full bodies and headers, 620,027 attachment records, 216,195
notes, 1,814,759 tasks, 3,178,282 calendar events; 166,168 employee user records. Counted by
parsing every export file with headers excluded (8 NUL-corrupted Task/Lead shards skipped).
Plus 20,923,362,834 rows in the Foundry datasets — invoices, open and cleared AR items,
credit memos, disputes and deductions, delivery and billing line items, pricing agreements and
material cost periods. Total: 21,260,145,175 rows.
